summary: Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew, later renamed Rehab with Dr. Drew, is a VH1 reality television series in which well-known people are treated for alcohol and drug addiction. Dr. Drew Pinsky and his staff treat the celebrities at the Pasadena Recovery Center in Pasadena, California. Pinsky also serves as executive producer of the first five seasons, which premiered January 10, 2008 and ran through 2011.
one_line: VH1 reality series following celebrities treated for drug and alcohol addiction by Dr. Drew Pinsky at the Pasadena Recovery Center.
